newsitem.title: UK: Triplex says Cook in error on shares.
newsitem.headline: Triplex says Cook in error on shares.

text.p: British engineering group Triplex Lloyd said on Monday that an assertion earlier today by its bid target William Cook about withdrawals of bid acceptances by shareholders was wrongly based.
Earlier, William Cook said that holders of 5.44 percent of William Cook's share capital had sent notice to Triplex withdrawing their acceptance of a hostile cash and shares bid by Triplex.
As a result, only 0.39 percent of William Cook's share capital had been pledged to the Triplex bid, it added.

Triplex said in statement it noted the move, but that it reflected a clerical error by a shareholder and should not be connected with arguments around the level of its bid, as William Cook's executive chairman Andrew Cook had done in his statement.

"Andrew Cook knows perfectly well that the withdrawal of acceptances in respect of 5.44 percent of William Cook's share capital is the result of one shareholder, who accepted the offer due to a clerical error, now correcting his position," Triplex said.
"No other conclusion should be drawn from the withdrawal of this acceptance," Triplex Lloyd added.
